title: Loved this tour!
text: Fabulous informative and engaging tour. Roberto was a wonderful guide. So knowledgeable and friendly.
author: Marissa_G

title: Fantastic Tour with Berta!
text: Our small group of eight was a perfect size for a tour with Berta. She was absolutely terrific! This was our first visit to the park and we loved it. The beautiful weather was a bonus.
author: Paul H

title: Beautiful place and wonderful guide
text:
It is a beautiful place. Its was crowded but our amazing guide Berta managed to make it quiet and beautiful. 
She had much greta info and helped us take pictures too! Highly recommend
author: Eva_B

title: Güell with Vincent!
text: Vincent was an absolute love. The best tour guide anyone could have. Knowledgeable. Very funny. And interesting. Answered all questions and made the tour so happy and enjoyable for the group.
author: Elysia_B

title: Transforming a walk around a beautiful park
text:
I recently took a Park Güell tour with Marc as part of a small group tour, and it completely transformed the experience. What could have been a simple walk around a beautiful park became something far more meaningful and engaging.
Marc made the tour feel personal and interactive, rather than like a standard group outing. He explained the original vision behind the park in a way that was easy to understand, bringing Antoni Gaudí’s ideas to life. I especially appreciated how he highlighted the symbolism in Gaudí’s designs—pointing out details and meanings that I would never have noticed on my ow
author: Monzo68

title: Amazing
text: Felipe was our guide. He was amazing - so informative! We all enjoyed our tour, definitely recommend! Sagrada Familia was so beautiful.
author: kristye896

title: Bringing History to Life
text: This tour truly brought Park Guell, La Sagrada Familia and the history of Gaudí to life. Miguel was an excellent tour guide and provided us with so many historical facts and pointed out small details we would have never seen on our own! Highly recommend the tour over simply purchasing tickets!
author: B3989NSmelissam

title: Our guide Paula had...
text: Our guide Paula had a beautiful energy and she knew how to transmit us a lot of information about the Park. The visit was very interesting, I recommend it without hesitation!
author: Antonio_C

title: Very Nice Tour
text: Our guide, Berta, was very informative and fun! We’re so glad that we chose to take a guided tour of Park Guel as Berta shared so many interesting things about the history up to today. Highly recommend!
author: Mary_M

title: Travelers Beware!
text:
Travelers beware!  Do NOT walk to the meeting place, take a bus, train, plane, or cab!!
The experience in the Park is amazing!  Our guide, Berta, was very enthusiastic and informative.
author: Gerald_H
